# Jenvu AI

> Institutional-grade AI trading intelligence for Gold. Jenvu is an extension-based XAU/USD desk combining an ICT/SMC signal engine, chart-aware AI chat and mandatory senior review on eligible plans.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Jenvu TradingView extension, signal engine and AI chart workflow.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Manage extension keys, plans, signals, usage and account settings.
- [AI Engine](/ai-engine): How the two-stage AI pipeline scores institutional gold setups.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Pro ($15/mo), Elite ($50/mo) and Ultra ($100/mo) token-wallet plans.
- [Download](/download): iOS and Android app downloads.
- [Insights](/insights): Daily AI-authored gold and macro market analysis.
- [Help Center](/help): Product guides for the TradingView extension, signal engine and trade journal.
- [About](/about): Mission and product philosophy behind Jenvu.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team.
